## Verification

## Voting-flow review

- [ ] This does not change the voting flow.
- [ ] Or, it updates reducer/interface/E2E behavior, accessibility announcements, and any relevant ADR.
- [ ] A Code Owner has reviewed this flow change before merge.

## Privacy and assets

- [ ] No vote number, candidate, party, vote state, identifier, or user-provided value is collected or logged.
- [ ] Any asset or third-party resource has documented rights and the required privacy/security review.
